svg.title: Developing Problem Solving Packages with AI Agents
svg.desc: An infrastructure admin connects to coderd in the Coder control plane, which uses PostgreSQL and a Terraform provisioner. The provisioner creates two workspace containers on a Docker host, each with a coder agent, a key and VS Code; container 1 also runs an AI coding agent that exchanges calls with an external LLM provider. Both VS Code instances connect two-way to a Git source control provider, which feeds a CI/CD build container that produces a problem solving package. A developer connects to each VS Code.
svg.text: Developing Problem Solving Packages with AI Agents
